The '''''Mandator IV''-class Siege Dreadnought''', also known as the '''''Mandator IV''-class warship''' and the '''First Order Dreadnought''', was a model of [[Siege Dreadnought]] utilized by the [[First Order]] during the [[Cold War]] against the [[New Republic]] and during the [[First Order-Resistance War]].

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|More firepower than a dozen Star Destroyers. Designed for large-scale planetary assault.|[[Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar]], on the Dreadnoughts|<ref name="The Last Jedi Adaptation 1">[[The Last Jedi Adaptation 1|''The Last Jedi Adaptation'' 1]]</ref>}}
[[File:MandatorIVPointDefenseCannons-SW.png|thumb|left|250px|The point-defense laser cannons on a ''Mandator IV''-class Siege Dreadnought.]]
The ''Mandator IV''-class [[Siege Dreadnought]] was a class of [[Star Dreadnought]] in the [[Mandator line|''Mandator'' line]].<ref name="TLJ:ICS" /> It was two-and-a-half times the length of the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]], coming in at 7,669.71 [[meter]]s.<ref name="SW.com" /> It boasted a crew of 53,000 [[First Order officer|officers]], 140,000 enlisted personnel, and 22,000 [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtroopers]].<ref name="TLJ:ICS" />

The ''Mandator IV''-class was armed with two [[orbital autocannon]]s that could fire a salvo of two rounds each in quick succession before a recharge was needed.<ref name="Episode VIII" /> These weapons dwarfed anything available to [[officer]]s like [[Moden Canady]] in the [[Imperial Navy]], and had been built to scour planets of life. A single shot could obliterate planetary [[deflector shield]]s as if they were an afterthought and turn a hundred cubic meters of crust into vapor and slag. It was considered the most dangerous enemy ship on the battlefield during the [[Battle of D'Qar]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Expanded Edition">''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Expanded Edition]]''</ref>

The [[starship]]'s dorsal surface featured twenty-six [[point-defense laser cannon]]s for protection against [[starfighter]]s, and six [[tractor beam projector]]s were located on the ship's bow.<ref name="TLJ:ICS" /> The ship was said to have more firepower than a dozen Star Destroyers combined.<ref name="The Star Wars Book">''[[The Star Wars Book]]''</ref> The design of the ''Mandator IV''-class was a test project that informed the [[Xyston-class Star Destroyer|''Xyston''-class Star Destroyer]] design.<ref name="TRoSVD">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

==History==
===Rise of the First Order===
[[File:MandatorIVBlueprints.png|thumb|right|Blueprints for the ''Mandator IV''-class discovered on board the ''Retribution'']]
The ''Mandator IV''-class Siege Dreadnought was among the hundreds of vessels developed by the First Order under the auspices of [[Project Resurrection]].<ref name="Battlefront II" /> Its design was inspired by [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader's]] flagship, the ''[[Executor]]''.<ref name="Fun Facts">{{SWKidsYouTube|series=Star Wars Galaxy of Adventures Fun Facts|text=Capital Ships|video=tgDnI96WuGs}}</ref>

After infiltrating the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Retribution]]'', [[Iden Versio]] and [[Dio]] sliced into the onboard computer terminals in order to gather information on [[Project Resurrection]]. They discovered, among other things, blueprints for the ''Mandator IV''-class Siege Dreadnought.<ref name="Battlefront II" />

===Battle of D'Qar===
[[File:FulminatrixBoom-TLJSB.png|thumb|left|250px|The ''Fulminatrix'' is destroyed.]]
During the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the First Order and the Resistance, the ''[[Fulminatrix]]'',<ref name="TLJ:ICS" /> commanded by [[Captain]] [[Moden Canady]], joined a group of three ''Resurgent''-class [[Star Destroyer]]s at [[D'Qar]] led by [[General]] [[Armitage Hux]]. The ''Fulminatrix'' and the rest of the First Order forces engaged in the [[Battle of D'Qar|siege of D'Qar]], where the ''Fulminatrix'' destroyed the [[Resistance base]] located there using its underbelly autocannons. As a counterattack, Resistance [[Commander]] Poe Dameron destroyed the point defense cannons using his [[T-70 X-wing starfighter]] ''[[Black One]]''. He proceeded to lead a bombing run of [[MG-100 StarFortress SF-17 heavy bomber|MG-100 StarFortress SF-17]] [[bomber]]s before the ''Fulminatrix'' could target the [[Resistance navy]]. After an intense space battle, the [[Cobalt Hammer|final]] Resistance bomber, though fatally damaged, managed to destroy the ''Fulminatrix'' and allow the Resistance to escape the [[Ileenium system]].<ref name="Episode VIII" />

Some time after its [[Battle of Castilon|escape]] from [[Castilon]], the ''[[Colossus]]'' arrived over D'Qar to the site of the battle. In desperate need of [[coaxium]], members of the ''Colossus'' raided the wreckage of the ''Fulminatrix'' which still had power. Although the First Order tracked the ''Colossus'' from Castilon to D'Qar and [[Skirmish over D'Qar|briefly engaged]] them, the ''Colossus'' was able to salvage coaxium from the ''Fulminatrix'' and jump to hyperspace.<ref name="Salvage Run">{{Resistance|A Quick Salvage Run}}</ref>

===Assault on Naboo & Annihilation on Tah'Nuhna===
[[File:MandatorIVDestroysTahNuhna-Allegiance1.png|thumb|right|225px|A ''Mandator IV''-class Siege Dreadnought fires on Tah'Nuhna.]]
After the [[Battle of Crait]], the First Order sent a [[Unidentified Mandator IV-class Siege Dreadnought|''Mandator IV''-class Siege Dreadnought]] to [[Darth Sidious|Emperor Palpatine]]'s homeworld of [[Naboo]] on the disguised Kylo Ren's orders during their [[Assault on Naboo (First Order)|assault]], only for it to run afoul of [[N-1 starfighter]]s, [[TIE/sk x1 experimental air superiority fighter|TIE Strikers]], and [[X-wing starfighter]]s. Despite losing their first auto cannon, the Dreadnought and its accompanying TIE Fighters eventually withdrew.<ref name="Legacy of Vader 5">[[Legacy of Vader 5|''Legacy of Vader'' 5]]</ref> Later, the First Order chased the Resistance and eventually discovered a Resistance signal had reached the [[planet]] [[Tah'Nuhna]], which was famous for its neutrality. In response, Hux led a [[fleet]] of ''Resurgent''-class Star [[Destroyer]]s and at least one ''Mandator IV''-class Siege Dreadnought. Despite the [[Tah'Nuhna (species)|Tah'Nuhna]] pleading that they were neutral and their culture compelled them to help travelers in need, Hux ordered the planet's [[Destruction of Tah'Nuhna|destruction]]. As a result, the ''Mandator IV''-class fired on the planet, while [[TIE/se Bomber]]s [[bomb]]ed areas and [[First Order snowtrooper|snowtroopers]] massacred the people in a [[city]].<ref name="Allegiance 1">[[Allegiance 1|''Allegiance'' 1]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:FO_Mandator_Dreadnought_ICS.png|thumb|left|250px|''Mandator IV''-class schematics]]
The ''Mandator IV''-class warship was unveiled on [[August 23]], [[2017]], on ''[[the Star Wars Show]]'' on YouTube, alongside the [[All Terrain MegaCaliber Six]], showcasing several vehicles that have appeared in {{Film|VIII}}.<ref name="SW.com" /><ref name="SWShow" />

According to [[Kevin Jenkins]], the design supervisor for ''The Last Jedi'', the ship was already indicated in the initial script, but its design did not occur until post-production. He also indicated that director [[Rian Johnson]] specifically requested a bigger battleship known as a dreadnought for the film and that it would act as a gun platform as well as a flat surface with lots of cannons on it. He also indicated that the design was taken from multiple real-world elements, namely World War II (especially the use of big guns among several things like the ''Yamato'' super-battleship and others) as well as the Korean War, and that the historical inspirations even went right up to the 1960s. He also indicated that similar to other ships in the [[sequel trilogy]], the ship was based largely on designs from the [[original trilogy]], at least insofar as it resembling an [[Industrial Light & Magic|ILM]] model. They ultimately decided on just using big guns instead of other elements like a ''Flash Gordon''–based design as well as radar equipment.<ref name="SW.com" />

The ''[[Star Wars: Card Trader]]'' app previously labeled this vessel a [[Mandator III-class dreadnought|''Mandator III''-class Siege Dreadnought]], which currently only exists in [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]], although this was corrected in the app.<ref name="SWCT">{{Topps|set=2018 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files|cardname=First Order Dreadnought}}</ref>
